messages:
Maria: Quick sync — final rollout checklist for next-week prod push. Major gaps I want resolved: SLA wording (public vs enterprise), docs for billing/pricing knobs, canary percentages + rollback triggers, and monitoring events mapping to SLOs. Who owns each?

Jon: I can take SLA wording. Will draft a short public-facing blurb and a separate enterprise appendix (legal can review). Target EOD Thu. :+1:

Alex: I'll own the canary plan and rollback triggers. Proposed traffic ramp: `0% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%` over 4 hours with health checks every 5m. Rollback if 5m error rate > 2% or p95 latency regression > 50ms. Thoughts?

Tina: That pacing sounds reasonable for hosted API. For Dedicated customers we should have a separate, slower ramp and explicit opt-in. Also doc the fallback model rules (which model we downgrade to if capacity constrained).

Samir: On monitoring, I'll map telemetry events to SLOs. Need names for events from runtime team: `request.latency_ms`, `request.error`, `cache.hit_rate`, `batch.size`. Can someone confirm exact metric names?

Alex: Runtime team confirmed: `inference.latency_ms`, `inference.error_count`, `kvcache.hit_ratio`, `batch.effective_size`. Use those.

Emma: I'll update the docs for pricing knobs. Two things: (1) an explicit table of quantization and batching recommendations per workload tier, (2) example cost calculations for sample apps. Need the quant profiles from Research.

Maria: Emma — add a quick example showing how enabling prefix caching reduces token cost by ~30% on chat workloads. Samir — once you map metrics, we need concrete alert thresholds for oncall.

Samir: Will propose thresholds: page if `inference.error_count > 10` in 5m or `inference.latency_ms.p95 > 1000` for 5m. Pager to eng-oncall channel. Lower-severity Slack alert for p50/p95 drift.

DeployBot: Deployment scheduled: canary window on 2024-09-12 16:00 UTC. Rolling deploy artifact: rwinference/v2.3.0. CI: green.

Kevin: On support: we need runbook owners and a clear escalation path. Recommend: first-line support handles billing/docs/usage; second-line (runtime) handles SLO hits; third-line (infra) for hardware/region issues. I'll draft the org chart.

Tina: Legal asked to add an SLA exceptions section for pilot customers (e.g., performance variability during quantization experiments). Small clause only.

Maria: OK — owners summary so I can send to execs: Jon (SLA text), Alex (canary + rollback), Emma (pricing docs + examples), Samir (monitoring + alerts), Kevin (support runbooks), Tina (enterprise/dedicated gating + fallback rules). I'll circulate a short acceptance checklist tomorrow AM.

Jon: Quick Q — pricing doc needs a clear statement on burst credits vs reserved capacity billing. Emma/Finance to confirm numbers?

Emma: Yup. Pulling numbers from FinOps — will add examples for a 1M token/month app on hosted vs dedicated.

Alex: Also calling out an action item: add a test prompt set for quality gating (prompt-regression). If quality drops > 5% on canary, we abort. Who owns prompts?

Maria: Research/QA to provide prompt set. Samir add quality metric to the deployment telemetry dashboard.

Samir: Added. Dashboard widget name: `deploy.quality_regression_rate`. Alert config pending.

Maria: Thanks — last thing: please update the docs page header with a short “prod readiness” checklist (SLA, docs, monitoring, pricing, support, rollback). I'll run a 20m shiproom on Monday with everyone. :calendar: 

Kevin: I'll be there. Can we do 09:00 PT?

Maria: 09:00 PT works. Invite coming.

Emma: I'll attach the pricing examples before the shiproom.

Alex: I'll attach the canary playbook and sample `promql` snippets:```
# Example health query
sum(rate(inference.error_count[5m])) by (region) > 10
p95_latency: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(inference.latency_ms_bucket[5m])) by (le))
```

Samir: Nice. I'll translate those into alerts in the runbook.

Maria: Great progress — please update the checklist doc in GH: `docs/prod-readiness/rollout-checklist.md` and tag me. Closing this thread for now. :rocket:
